mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id AND rp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.type IN ('menu', 'button') AND p.code IS NOT NULL AND p.code != ''
